title: nan
authors: Rana A.; Petitti A.; Milella A.
key_contribution: Presents a wall-detection and following navigation method with plane-estimation self-localization for robotic inspection of vertical surfaces in GNSS-denied environments, validated in laboratory and field.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
